description_en: The Religious Authority and the Caliphate after the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) 26 / Blessed Month of Ramadan / 1432
summary: This lecture by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari discusses Hadith al-Manzila as part of a series on the religious authority and the caliphate after the Prophet.
series_en: Debates in Creed - The Religious Authority and the Caliphate after the Prophet
